post.title: Why Your Brain Replays Your To-Do List at Night #shorts
post.description: Zeigarnik (1927): unfinished tasks stay more active in memory than finished ones. Masicampo & Baumeister (2011): writing a specific plan for the next step reduced intrusive thoughts about unfinished goals. Write the next step, then close the laptop. #psychology #shorts #sleep #productivity
